I teach courses in the [Department of Electrical Engineering](https://teknik-elektro.fst.unja.ac.id/), Faculty of Science and Technology, Universitas Jambi. My teaching areas sit at the intersection of artificial intelligence, data science, and computational systems. They draw on what I learned as a data scientist in industry and on the research I run with students here.

## Courses

- [Artificial Intelligence](artificial-intelligence/index.qmd)
- [Machine Learning](machine-learning/index.qmd)
- [Data Mining](data-mining/index.qmd)
- [Pattern Recognition](pattern-recognition/index.qmd)
- [Pengolahan Citra Digital](pengolahan-citra-digital/index.qmd) (Digital Image Processing)

## Teaching Philosophy

I believe students learn best by doing. My courses combine:

- **Clear theory**: the mathematical foundations behind algorithms, explained from first principles.
- **Hands-on practice**: executable notebooks and small projects on real, locally relevant datasets.
- **Industry perspective**: examples drawn from data-science practice in retail and media, where models must be robust, interpretable, and production-ready.

## Supervision

I supervise undergraduate student projects and theses (tugas akhir/skripsi) in topics such as:

- Machine learning and deep learning applications
- Computer vision and pattern recognition
- IoT systems and embedded intelligence
- Time-series forecasting and predictive systems
